plain_meaning: Your dog is talking or alert.
what_to_do: Nothing. This is a happy normal sound.

plain_meaning: Your dog may be in pain scared or needs something.
what_to_do: Check on your dog. Watch for limping or hiding.

plain_meaning: Your dog feels threatened or is guarding.
what_to_do: Give space. Look for what is upsetting them.

plain_meaning: Sudden sharp cry. Your dog may be hurt right now.
what_to_do: Check your dog's body now for injury.

plain_meaning: Your dog is calling out or lonely.
what_to_do: Company usually helps.

plain_meaning: Repeated coughing can mean a chest or heart problem.
what_to_do: Call a vet if it keeps happening.

plain_meaning: Normal cooling or excitement.
what_to_do: Nothing unless very heavy for a long time.

plain_meaning: Your cat is talking to you.
what_to_do: Nothing. Normal cat chat.

plain_meaning: Your cat is calm.
what_to_do: Nothing. Usually contentment.

plain_meaning: Your cat feels scared or cornered.
what_to_do: Give space and remove the threat.

plain_meaning: Loud drawn-out cry. Pain stress or distress.
what_to_do: Check on your cat. Call a vet if it repeats.

plain_meaning: Your cat is warning you to back off.
what_to_do: Give space.

plain_meaning: Coughing or wheezing can mean asthma or illness.
what_to_do: Call a vet if it keeps happening.

plain_meaning: A kitten crying a lot may be cold or hungry.
what_to_do: Warm and feed. Check on it.

plain_meaning: Normal herd call.
what_to_do: Nothing.

plain_meaning: Loud repeated bellowing can mean pain or separation.
what_to_do: Check the animal and the herd.

plain_meaning: Normal horse call.
what_to_do: Nothing.

plain_meaning: Groaning can mean colic or belly pain.
what_to_do: Call a vet. Colic is urgent.

plain_meaning: Normal sheep or goat call.
what_to_do: Nothing.

plain_meaning: Fast repeated bleating can mean distress or separation.
what_to_do: Check the animal.

plain_meaning: Loud squealing can mean fear or pain.
what_to_do: Check the animal.

plain_meaning: Normal pig chatter.
what_to_do: Nothing.

plain_meaning: Normal territorial call.
what_to_do: Nothing. Expected for big cats.

plain_meaning: An unusual high cry can mean pain or trouble.
what_to_do: Alert the keeper.

plain_meaning: Normal elephant call.
what_to_do: Nothing.

plain_meaning: Unusual low rumbling can signal stress.
what_to_do: Alert the keeper.

plain_meaning: An unusual loud or sharp cry for this animal.
what_to_do: Check the animal. Call a vet or keeper if it repeats.

plain_meaning: Too quiet for too long from a usually vocal animal.
what_to_do: Check the animal is okay and moving.
